'''Semmix''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Argullian]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Argul|Battle of]] [[Argul]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] began an evacuation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. There was a limited number of [[Transport/Legends|transports]] and Semmix tried to prevent 42 terminal patients of his from being loaded onto them. The patients were Argullians who had been denied inoculations because they had [[Marriage/Legends|married]] without the proper licenses. The [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Ren Auglu]] argued with him about his decision.

==Personality and traits==
Semmix believed that people who married without the authorization of the state were degenerates who only did so for sexual gratification. He believed that places on the transports should be allocated to healthier, more respectable Argullians and was proud of his moral stance on the issue.
